governed.config: detekt runs with its own default rule set; the project's detekt-config.yml is part of the plan but is not passed to the tool, so the project's rule choices do not apply

en.label: detekt (Kotlin)
en.purpose: A static analyzer for Kotlin: code smells, complexity, error-prone constructs, empty blocks, naming and potential bugs.
en.limitation: It runs on the project's sources with its default rules and without the project's compiled classes, so the rules that need type resolution do not run.
en.needs: Nothing beyond the tools image: the Java runtime it carries (about 1.5 GB of memory), no network and no project dependencies.

pt-BR.label: detekt (Kotlin)
pt-BR.purpose: Um analisador estático de Kotlin: code smells, complexidade, construções propensas a erro, blocos vazios, nomes e possíveis bugs.
pt-BR.limitation: Roda sobre os fontes do projeto com as regras padrão e sem as classes compiladas do projeto, então as regras que precisam de resolução de tipos não rodam.
pt-BR.needs: Nada além da imagem de ferramentas: o runtime Java que ela traz (cerca de 1,5 GB de memória), sem rede e sem as dependências do projeto.
